gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohin: Commanding from the first glyph, Baumans bends every stroke to one thickness, its c gaping like a wrench. And Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya, a sans-serif body, keeps its own wide c approachable at any size.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Curves that never thin out give Baumans its loud, wrench-open c and a stubbornly uniform outline. Yet Noto Sans Hatran, plain sans through and through, does the quieter work, its funnel-wide e keeping text moving.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Baumans draws every stroke like a drafting pen, one steady line, with a c opened wide as a wrench. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi, the sans below, keeps small counters unclogged.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Baumans keeps its stroke flat and unmodulated, a heading font built to make statements at a glance. Noto Sans Javanese, the sans-serif body, quietly keeps its counters connected to the space outside.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Wire-bent sign lettering, that is Baumans, holding constant thickness through every turn, its c gaping like a wrench. Noto Sans Kawi's sans text echoes that open jaw with a pliers-like c.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Lines that hold their width through every turn: that is Baumans. Noto Sans Linear A is the sans-serif body, and its visibly gaping c holds that open gesture at any size.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Distinctive in a blunt way, Baumans uses plain constant-width lines, its c wrenched wide open. Then Noto Sans Linear B, plain sans of a modern sort, gives the eye a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: A single-weight line, plotter-pen steady, is what defines Baumans, c flung wide like a wrench. Noto Sans Manichaean, the sans-serif body, handles the fine work, with e crossbars that open their mouths.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Commanding up top, Baumans lets downstrokes and connecting curves match, with no thick-thin shift. And Noto Sans Mongolian, the sans below, flares its terminals outward so text keeps moving down the page.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: The text reads in round letters that look cupped, not clenched, beneath the glass-tube lettering of Baumans. Noto Sans New Tai Lue, the sans, lets that heading speak up while it stays out of the way.
